Specification of Communication Management
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
If one or more update messages are received the E2E state machine provides one
of the following results:
OK
,
ERROR
,
REPEATED
,
NONEWDATA
,
WRONGSEQUENCE
(See
[PRS_E2E_00597]). Only result
OK
indicates that the received value is valid.
Figure 7.31 shows reception of a field update message.
